shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- src/App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- src/main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.html ---\\n' && cat index.html && printf '\\n--- vite.config.ts ---\\n' && cat vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- ThemeProvider.d.ts ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- useTheme.d.ts ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- ThemeContext.d.ts ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- types.d.ts ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- useThemeValue.d.ts ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- useThemeType.d.ts ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js && printf '\\n--- useThemeContext ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeContext.js && printf '\\n--- getThemeType ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/getThemeType.js && printf '\\n--- useThemeType ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.js"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100 && printf '\\n--- Switch types ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && printf '\\n--- Switch index ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && printf '\\n--- Switch.d.ts ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | rg -n \"ControlProps\" -A 15 -B 2 && printf '\\n--- Switch.js ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.js && printf '\\n--- ThemeSettingsContext ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git log --oneline --all -10 && printf '\\n--- branch/status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- README? ---\\n' && find . -maxdepth 2 -iname 'README*' -o -iname 'AGENTS.md' -print"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"import('@gravity-ui/uikit').then(m=>{const keys=['ThemeProvider','useTheme','useThemeValue','useThemeType','Switch','Theme']; for(const k of keys) console.log(k, typeof m[k]);})\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/types.d.ts | head -120 && printf '\\n--- Card.d.ts ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts && printf '\\n--- package version/name ---\\n' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:5173/src/App.tsx | head -20; echo '--- main ---'; curl -sS http://localhost:5173/src/main.tsx | head -20; echo '--- root html ---'; curl -sS http://localhost:5173/ | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:5173/ | head -20; echo '--- app module ---'; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:5173/src/App.tsx | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'test -d node_modules/jsdom && echo jsdom-present || echo no-jsdom; test -d node_modules/@testing-library/react && echo rtl-present || echo no-rtl; ls node_modules/.bin | head -50'
